implementation.Extort: Ordinary own-any-spell cast trigger, one optional resolution payment of exactlyW orB through existing alternative-mana payment. Untargeted opponent life loss passes through central actual event logic, followed by gain of the actual amount lost. Trigger has captured controller and remains independent of departed source. Existing life gain additions/prohibitions apply.
implementation.attack_trigger: One ordinary whole-declaration trigger for attacking with one or more creatures, whether Kingpin attacks or not. Existing optional-life prompt is followed explicitly by actual2life loss, then the rule effect. Unaffordable payment skips both following instructions.
implementation.combat_rule: Owned cold two-player flag, independent of source or fixed recipient list, expires at actual cleanup. Assignment getter reads current controller and current signed stats; use toughness only while toughness>power, then clamp assignment at0. Both attackers and blockers use this getter before ordinary assignment, trample and damage replacements. Actual power/characteristics and noncombat power damage never change.
